findings.claim: Dropping `workspaceRoot` removes the workspace-relative guard, so the "external node_modules" classification now depends only on the path shape — declarations under a workspace-local `node_modules` (e.g. symlinked monorepo packages, pnpm store links) will now be classified as external and their JSDoc silently discarded (or the inverse, if the guard was negated).
findings.rationale: The removed `workspaceRoot` was the only input distinguishing in-workspace from out-of-workspace declaration files; the remaining `declarations.every(...)` predicate can no longer make that distinction, so the set of symbols whose JSDoc is suppressed changes. Whether this is a widening or narrowing depends on the predicate body, which is outside the hunk, but either way generated OpenAPI descriptions can change for local packages resolved through node_modules. Medium confidence — the exact predicate is not visible.

findings.claim: If any code further down in `getJsDocComment` (below the hunk) still calls `isWithinPath`, this deletion leaves a dangling reference and the file will not compile.
findings.rationale: The helper was a local closure used somewhere later in the same function; the diff only shows the removal, not the corresponding update to its call site. Low-to-medium confidence, but a cheap thing to verify since it is a hard build break if missed.

findings.claim: `path.relative` / `path.isAbsolute` were likely the only uses of the `path` import in this file; after this removal the `path` import may be unused and fail `noUnusedLocals`/lint.
findings.rationale: Both `path` usages visible in this function are deleted here, and the surviving `normalize` uses a plain regex replace rather than `path`. If no other site in the module imports/uses `path`, the build or lint step breaks. Low confidence since the rest of the file isn't shown.
